item.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeats Republican Mike Rogers in key Michigan Senate race
item.description: El-Sayed's campaign tested how an antiestablishment candidate on the left would fare in a perennial Midwest battleground. With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.
item.content:encoded:
El-Sayed's campaign tested how an antiestablishment candidate on the left would fare in a perennial Midwest battleground. With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.

(Image credit: Spencer Platt)

item.title: Republicans tried to gerrymander their way out of big congressional losses. It didn't work
item.description: Among the sweeping victories by Democrats on Tuesday were wins in several congressional districts that Republicans had redrawn explicitly to boost their party ahead of the midterms.
item.content:encoded:
Among the sweeping victories by Democrats on Tuesday were wins in several congressional districts that Republicans had redrawn explicitly to boost their party ahead of the midterms.

(Image credit: Vasha Hunt)

item.title: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries declares "America is back"
item.description: Jeffries, who addressed supporters after House control was called for Democrats, argued voters have sent Congress a message to end extremism and "corruption."
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Troy Jackson wins Maine Senate race over Susan Collins, in major coup for Democrats
item.description: The result is a crucial victory for Democrats in their push to retake the Senate majority, flipping a seat that Collins has held for nearly 30 years.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Democrats win full control of Congress, ushering in a new era of divided government
item.description: The victories in the House and Senate return Democrats to full control of Congress for the first time since 2023 and deepens the level of expected friction between them and President Trump.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Democrat David Crowley will be Wisconsin's first Black governor
item.description: Democrat David Crowley defeated Republican Congressman Tom Tiffany in a campaign that focused on "lowering costs for working families" and bringing more jobs to Wisconsin.
